metadata.description: This itinerary titled “Upham Itinerary” lists stays in Yokohama, Manila, Singapore, Calcutta, Bombay, Cairo, and Naples, with dates extending from December through April. It gives American Express Company forwarding addresses in each city, including a second Italian address in Genoa, and mailing-date ranges from Oxford, Ohio.

Manila December 27 - January 5 American Express Co. 83 Plaza Moraga (P. O. Box 1463) Manila, P. I. [Philippine Islands] November 24 - December 1

Singapore January 9 - 27 American Express Co. No. 1, Collyer Quay Singapore, Straits Settlements December 1 - 14

Calcutta February 6 - 7 American Express Co. 14-15 Government Place, East (P. O. Box 2311) Calcutta, India December 14 - January 1

Bombay February 17 - 18 American Express Co. 82-84 Esplanade Road, Fort (P. O. Box 507) Bombay, India January 1 - 21

Cairo February 28 - March 14 American Express Co. Continental Savoy Bldg. [Building] (P. O. Box 2160) Cairo, Egypt January 21 - February 28

Naples and Italy March 19 - April 10 American Express Co. 23a Piazza dei Martiri [Martyrs' Square] Naples, Italy February 28 - March 15

American Express Co. Via Balbi [Balbi Street] (Hotel Colombia [Colombia Hotel]) Genoa, Italy March 15 - 30
